notes.title: Devlog #019
notes.content:
We finish up the Job System with the Science Job Tree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/9043fe084d305cb13a2f8672167249ca77d4a480.jpg[/img]

[h1]Science Tree[/h1]

The Science Job Tree or the Blue Shirts are responsible for Science and for progressing the Space Station.

[h2]Astro Technician[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/6c9711fc7fc8fef547bbb3134a1d69baa219a570.jpg[/img]
Astro Technicians are started Blue Shirts that do perform easy researches and basic operations tasks.

[h2]Astro Researcher[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/19fcb211639760a0686e58670f673b32fac58e98.jpg[/img]
Astro Researchers are mostly responsible for discovering new technologies and blueprints for the Space Station through Research and Analysis.

[h2]Space Botanist[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/0352647726f0b49e1e305dd12880ff00d21293ee.jpg[/img]
Space Botanists are responsible for growing plants for food and commerce on the Space Station.

[h2]Station Nurse[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/a65abbb98d84514ea1e320a26ecc5f4876b60eea.jpg[/img]
Station Nurses can help guests have been injured and perform basic medical operations.

[h2]Space Agriculturalist[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/1110298e86ad4a06c5da481465649fcf10da9ea5.jpg[/img]
Space Agriculturalist are responsible for advanced plant botany and rearing basic space creatures.

[h2]Station Doctor[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/6e352414633cb76353a82017a0b746abebd24279.jpg[/img]
Station Doctors can treat advanced ailments and perform basic augmentations.

[h2]Astro Physicist[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/5648b9df1ad23dcf224abd05e3dd34d935d5e28c.jpg[/img]
Astro Physicists are responsible for the most advanced researches including analyses and simulations. They can discover the most illusive technologies for use within the Space Station.

[h2]Space Ecologist[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/9d2b9892bf86387cd4af375446a4f1073fab7a24.jpg[/img]
Space Ecologists can cultivate the most advanced plants and rear the most dangerous creatures in the galaxy within the Space Station.

[h2]Station Surgeon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/fc4068aa177bbf3056a9e1e1afe203b3f5175599.jpg[/img]
Station Surgeons can treat virtually all ailments and perform the most complex augmentations for all races.

[h2]Starfield Visionary[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/1db4eb45b1ed083c3021c125b4f3994a73dfaa50.jpg[/img]
Starfield Visionary is the head of all Science within the Space Station. This is a late game job and only one unit can be appointed to this job.

notes.title: Devlog #015
notes.content:
Power Grid Machines contribute towards the Space Station’s Power Grid.

[h2]Power Generators[/h2]

Power Generators directly contribute Power to the Space Station’s Power Grid. Here are 2 kinds of Power Generators - Hydrogen Power Generator and Fusion Power Generator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/5935fc11a514a476b610241c6e30da68f1af668f.jpg[/img]
[previewyoutube=c4wSAbE2ZaE;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/ba3b913841cc1f2d2887bcfce228c38ec13b9cc8.jpg[/img]
[previewyoutube=y9OGmb6JYLM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Batteries[/h2]

Batteries serve as a Storage of Power Capacity and contribute to the Power Grid when Power Generators are not enough to meet the Power Requirements of various machines connected to the grid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/de340ed093d04860388c42116925a5627e493fa9.jpg[/img]
[previewyoutube=KPq66iqVRgc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Capacitors[/h2]

Capacitors provide instantaneous Power to nearby machines during spikes in power requirements in the grid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/fdb70c17b70cb57af61a66b4440c80e535c80e59.jpg[/img]
[previewyoutube=UhrDJqqQEg4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog #010
notes.content:
This week we are showcasing the Life Support Pods which allow units in the game to relieve themselves.

[h2]Bio-Pods[/h2]

Bio-Pods are designed for Human units where they can relieve themselves and increase their Hygiene Levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/728a664d51d46786ca0d6144c5e888af83cabb58.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/65ec7694951dfd7834c2bafbc2910abd477ce2fe.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=XJEAPNl869Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Sili-Pods[/h2]

Sili-Pods are designed for Silvian units and work very similarly to the Bio-Pods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/f15a36603c87f0baaa861ecb243339e1236278a0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/2880f2a52850697f3f75a6180619a9b39b45fcca.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=LpyADQQ_G14;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Droid-Pods[/h2]

Droid-Pods are designed for Androids and work a little differently compared to the Bio-Pods and Sili-Pods. Androids have a Corruption level that must be removed every once in a while. A Droid-Pod resets an Android’s Corruption level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/56175ca38532715e945bdcbb52ee05c5b62fe42e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/246796d8f312172a4eb03f39ff94ac7095510cf1.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=d4Ib9aJVLqA;full][/previewyoutube]
